info.description: RESTful API for the Dalista shopping-list / shop-catalog sharing application.
info.title: Dalista API

get.description: Totals (public lists, stars) plus the top public lists by star count, for the dashboard.

parameters.description: Number of top lists to return (default 10)
parameters.name: top

post.description: Admin-only. Sends a message to each selected user's phone via SMS Misr. Users without a phone are skipped.
post.summary: Send an SMS to selected users (admin)

get.description: Subscriptions joined to owner contact fields, optionally filtered by tier and billing rail.
Counts of subscriptions by tier, billing rail, and status for the dashboard.

post.description: Verifies a Facebook access token server-side, then signs in or creates the account. Returns access + refresh tokens.
post.summary: Sign in / sign up with Facebook

post.description: Verifies a Google ID token server-side, then signs in or creates the account. Returns access + refresh tokens.
post.summary: Sign in / sign up with Google

post.description: Stateless logout. Tokens are not server-side revocable in v1; the client discards them. Endpoint exists for a consistent contract and future revocation.
Sends a one-time code to the phone number. No account required — a new one is created on verify.
Verifies the code and signs in (creating the account on first use). Returns access + refresh tokens.
For an authenticated user who signed up via email/Google/Facebook — sends an OTP to the phone they want to verify.
Confirms the OTP and marks the authenticated user's phone verified.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair.
Creates an email/password account and returns access + refresh tokens. Phone verification is a separate post-signup step.
Apple delivers a JWS `signedPayload`; verified against the x5c chain, then the subscription state is synced. Public endpoint (authenticity is the signature).
post.summary: App Store Server Notifications V2 webhook

post.description: Server-side validation of a StoreKit transaction via the App Store Server API, then activates the tier. The client never self-reports entitlement.
Decodes the Pub/Sub envelope, re-verifies the purchase token against the Play Developer API (the real trust boundary), then syncs subscription state. Public endpoint.
post.summary: Google Play Real-time Developer Notifications (Pub/Sub push)

post.description: Server-side validation of a Play Billing purchase token via the Play Developer API, then activates the tier.

get.summary: Get my storage usage vs. quota

get.description: Returns the caller's current subscription (or the implicit free tier).

delete.summary: Delete a comment (author or list owner)

post.description: Persists a comparison from a manually selected set of item IDs (own, shared, or public catalog). At least two accessible items required.

get.description: Returns a comparison you own, with its items. Items you can no longer access are withheld (see the withheld count).

post.description: Generates (or returns the existing) share token for a comparison you own. The token is the shareable reference; it grants no new item access — recipients only see items they can already access.
Registers (or refreshes) the caller's FCM device token. Idempotent per token; a token re-registering under a new account is reassigned.

delete.description: Removes one of the caller's device tokens (e.g. on logout). Idempotent.

get.description: Per-user counts of owned items/lists and starred public lists, by category.

delete.summary: Delete a grouped list (nested lists become standalone)

get.description: Returns 200 when the API and its database are reachable, 503 otherwise.

put.summary: Update an item (clear_category moves it to MISC)

delete.description: Editor+. Generic todo-style "bought / included" state, used on today's lists and other non-periodic lists.

put.description: Editor+. Generic todo-style "bought / included" state, used on today's lists and other non-periodic lists.

post.description: Any list member may comment, including viewers. Records a comment_added activity event.
Editor+. Field name `image`. Max 10 MB, up to 6 images per item; types JPEG/PNG/WebP/HEIC/GIF. Size counts against the storage quota.
post.summary: Upload a photo for an item (multipart)

delete.description: Editor+. Removes the stored object and releases the storage quota.

put.description: Editor+ on a periodic list. Records a state transition and an auto system comment ("Marked as need to buy" / "We have enough").
put.summary: Toggle an item's need-to-buy state (periodic lists)

get.summary: List lists (optionally filtered by grouped list)
List a list's collaborators (+ invites, for the owner)

post.summary: Add an item to a list (omit category_id for MISC)

post.description: Creates an immediate share if the phone belongs to a registered user, else a pending invite auto-attached when that number is verified. Enforces the owner's tier per-list user cap.
post.summary: Share a list by phone (owner only)

get.description: Returns the periodic list's items currently marked need-to-buy — the candidate set to confirm/exclude before generating a variant.

post.description: Snapshots the current need-to-buy items (minus any excluded, which are marked "enough") into a new dated ListVariant.

Generates a real, non-periodic List from the periodic list's current need-to-buy items (minus any excluded). It behaves like a normal list and is nested under its parent. Adds an "added to today's list" system comment on each source item. Editor+.
post.summary: Create a one-time "today's list" from a periodic list

400.description: Not a periodic list / no items

get.summary: List the one-time "today's lists" under a periodic list

put.description: Partial update — only provided fields change.

get.description: Paginated feed of public lists, most-starred first, optionally filtered by category. Each item includes whether you've starred it.

post.description: Stars a public list for the caller (idempotent). Returns the current star count.

delete.description: Removes the caller's star from a public list (idempotent). Returns the current star count.

get.description: Returns a shared comparison by its token, showing only the items the viewer can access (public catalog or lists they can read). Others are withheld.
Chronological feed of activity across the lists you can access, newest first. Paginate with `before` (RFC3339).

parameters.description: Return events older than this RFC3339 timestamp
parameters.name: before

get.summary: Get a variant with its items

quota_bytes.description: -1 when unlimited (not used today; max tier is 50 GB)

extra.description: Extra holds arbitrary custom key/values (the XD "Add Other" row).

url.description:
Optional well-known attributes. Each is independent; omit to leave unset,
send "" to clear. URL is format-checked when non-empty.

skipped.description: users not found or without a phone

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer " followed by your access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
